# Wash-day checklist

Planned settings and actual settings are recorded separately and the actual never replaces the
planned. A deviation is the difference between the two, and it is only visible if both
survive.

## Before the load

- [ ] Planned settings recorded: `tools/pilot.py wash <GARMENT>`
- [ ] `tools/pilot.py gate ready_to_wash <GARMENT>` passes
- [ ] Offcut wash assignment decided and recorded, alternating L/R against the previous garment
- [ ] Filler load weighed or counted

## Record for the actual run (`tools/pilot.py wash <GARMENT> --actual`)

- [ ] machine make/model
- [ ] location
- [ ] cycle name
- [ ] water temperature (C)
- [ ] spin (rpm)
- [ ] detergent brand
- [ ] detergent amount (ml)
- [ ] filler load
- [ ] start time
- [ ] end time
- [ ] dryer method
- [ ] dryer setting
- [ ] dryer duration (min)
- [ ] conditioning start
- [ ] conditioning end
- [ ] which samples were in this load

Every field that differs from the plan becomes a recorded deviation automatically. Do not
'fix' the plan to match what happened.
